info.name: Pax Logistics - Delhivery B2C
info.description: Admin-only Delhivery B2C lifecycle API. Read-only requests can be run as a smoke suite. Mutating requests are skipped unless allowMutating=true in the selected environment.

exec: var body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('Pax proxy reports success', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('A normalized single waybill is returned', function () {

request.description: Allocates exactly one Delhivery waybill per request. The production limit is 750 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The returned AWB is saved as fetchedSingleWaybill; copy it to manifestWaybill only when you intentionally create that shipment. This request is mutation-locked by default.

exec: pm.test('Normalized waybill batch is returned', function () {

request.description: Allocates 1-10,000 unique waybills through Delhivery's bulk endpoint. Delhivery allows at most 50,000 waybills and 5 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Waybills are generated in backend batches of 25, so save the returned list and wait before copying one into manifestWaybill for shipment creation. This request is mutation-locked by default.

exec: pm.test('Warehouse creation response is normalized', function () {

request.description: Registers a case-sensitive Delhivery pickup-location name and its return address before shipment creation. Required fields are name, phone, pin, and return_address; optional documented fields are forwarded only when non-empty. This mutation is locked unless allowMutating=true. Delhivery's production limit is 10 requests per minute per IP.

exec: pm.test('Warehouse update response is normalized', function () {

request.description: Updates address, pin, and/or phone for the exact case-sensitive warehouse name; the name itself cannot be changed. The official sample omits pin, so the proxy accepts any non-empty subset of address, pin, and phone while validating provided values. This mutation is locked unless allowMutating=true. Delhivery's production limit is 10 requests per minute per IP.

request.description: Creates an RVP/Pickup shipment with Delhivery QC 3.0. qc_type is always param. Complete the one-time client-question-ID to Delhivery-question-ID mapping with the Delhivery BD team first, then replace qcSerialQuestionId and qcColorQuestionId with the mapped client IDs. The proxy rejects more than 2 QC items or more than 6 questions per item so the shipment cannot silently degrade to non-QC. This mutation is locked unless allowMutating=true.

request.description: Creates an MPS manifest. Every box must have a distinct prefetched waybill. master_id identifies one of those AWBs and is repeated on every provider shipment; shipment_type=MPS, mps_children, and mps_amount are normalized by the backend. For COD, mps_amount must equal the sum of package amounts; for prepaid it must be zero.
Forward edit example. Default variables demonstrate Prepaid-to-COD, which requires cod. Set target to Pre-paid and remove cod for COD-to-Prepaid. Same-mode and Pickup/REPL conversions are rejected.
Pickup/RVP edits are allowed only while Scheduled. Payment-mode conversion is intentionally omitted because Pickup conversions are unsupported.
REPL edits are allowed in Manifested, In Transit, or Pending. REPL payment-mode conversions are unsupported.

exec: pm.test('Pickup request response is normalized', function () {

request.description: Creates one warehouse-based pickup request after manifested shipments are packed. pickup_location must exactly match the registered Delhivery warehouse; pickup_date is set to tomorrow and pickup_time must be HH:mm:ss. Delhivery permits only one open request per warehouse/day, so an existing request is returned as an idempotent success. This mutation is locked unless allowMutating=true.

exec: pm.test('NDR action returns an asynchronous UPL ID', function () {

request.description: Submits Delhivery's asynchronous RE-ATTEMPT action and stores the returned UPL ID. Verify that the current NSL is one of EOD-74, EOD-15, EOD-104, EOD-43, EOD-86, EOD-11, EOD-69, or EOD-6 and the attempt count is 1 or 2. Delhivery recommends applying the action after 9 PM. current_nsl and attempt_count are local safety metadata and are not forwarded to Delhivery.

exec: pm.test('Pickup reschedule returns an asynchronous UPL ID', function () {

request.description: Submits PICKUP_RESCHEDULE exactly as documented (it is not remapped to DEFER_DLV) and stores the returned UPL ID. Use only for a non-OTP-cancelled Pickup AWB whose current NSL is EOD-777 or EOD-21 and attempt count is 1 or 2. Delhivery recommends applying it after 9 PM. current_nsl and attempt_count are local safety metadata and are not forwarded.
Updates the forward or return e-waybill for the selected shipment. The backend forwards only dcn and ewbn in Delhivery's documented data array. This mutation is locked unless allowMutating=true.

Cancels a COD/Prepaid shipment in Manifested, In Transit, or Pending. Manifested remains Manifested/UD; In Transit or Pending becomes In Transit/RT. Query metadata validates eligibility locally and is not sent to Delhivery.
Cancels a scheduled Pickup/RVP shipment. The expected outcome is Canceled with status type CN.
Cancels a REPL shipment in Manifested, In Transit, or Pending. Pending cancellation remains In Transit with status type RT.
